title: Plugins
steps: ⌘⇧P, Show plugins. Every plugin is listed: the three built-ins (Open by name, Command list, History) and Word count, a workspace plugin this Preview starts with. Each says where it's from, whether it's on, and what it adds.
⌘⇧P, Show word count: the workspace plugin's panel. Its code is `.common-ink/plugins/word-count/index.js`, a file: find it with ⌘P, or Source in the Plugins view.
Customize a built-in: on Command list, press Customize. Its code opens as `.common-ink/plugins/commandBar.commands/index.js`. Change `placeholder: "Run a command"` to `placeholder: "What next?"`.

The status bar says `Plugin changes apply after reload · Reload`, and Command list is marked Reload needed. Press Reload, then ⌘⇧P: the bar says "What next?". The Plugins view lists Command list as Customized.
History shows your change to the copy like any other.
Revert to built-in deletes the copy (history shows it as Deleted, and Undo brings it back). Reload: ⌘⇧P says "Run a command" again.

Turn History off with its checkbox: it writes `plugins.disabled` to workspace settings, as a change by you. Reload, and the history commands are gone; the Plugins view still lists what History would add. Turn it back on.

Break a plugin: in word-count's index.js, add `throw new Error("oops")` as the first line of `activate`, and reload. A notice says Word count didn't start, with Open in safe mode. The Plugins view shows it as Failed with the error, and everything else works.
Open in safe mode (`?safe=1`): only built-ins run, and Word count says Not loaded: safe mode. Leave safe mode from the banner, fix the file, reload.
Source on a built-in shows its code read-only. History's Customize is off: it uses the app's own modules, so a copy can't run on its own yet.
Open settings (⌘,): Plugins disabled says Applies after reload.
